recipes.name: SMASH BURGERS
ingredients: 4 tbsp unsalted butter, cubed and at room temperature
instructions: For the Potato Buns

In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine flour, potato flakes, yeast, salt, and sugar. Whisk to combine. - 415 g bread flour - 45 g potato flakes - 1 tbsp instant yeast - 1 tbsp kosher salt - 2 tbsp sugar
Add water, milk, and eggs. Attach the dough hook and mix on medium-low speed until the dough comes together. - 170 g (75 to 80° F) water - 110 g (75 to 80° F) whole milk - 2 eggs room temperature
Increase the speed to medium-high, adding the butter one tablespoon at a time. Wait until each piece is incorporated before adding the next. - 4 tbsp unsalted butter cubed and at room temperature
Mix for 5-6 minutes until the dough is supple and elastic. The dough should pass the ‘windowpane’ test.
Transfer to a greased bowl, cover and proof at room temperature for 1-1.5 hours or until doubled in size.
Turn the dough out onto a well-oiled surface. Divide into 5 equal portions, shape each into a round, and place on a parchment-lined sheet tray. Flatten each gently. - For the Potato Buns
Cover loosely with greased plastic wrap and proof for another 45 minutes to 1 hour until puffed. - For the Potato Buns
Brush with egg wash and bake at 350° F for 15-20 minutes until golden brown. - For the Potato Buns - egg wash (see below)
For the Egg Wash
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg, egg yolk, and a pinch of salt until combined. - 1 egg - 1 egg yolk - pinch of salt
For the Smash Burgers
In a large bowl, combine the ground chuck, brisket, and short rib, mixing by hand until evenly distributed. - 16 oz ground chuck - 8 oz ground brisket - 8 oz ground boneless short rib
Form into eight 4 oz balls. - 16 oz ground chuck - 8 oz ground brisket - 8 oz ground boneless short rib
Preheat a large cast iron skillet over high heat with 1 tbsp of oil (or preheat the grill to 500° F with a skillet inside). Add oil to the hot skillet. - neutral oil as needed

Place two beef balls in the skillet. Use a stiff metal spatula to smash them to a diameter about ½ inch wider than your bun. - 16 oz ground chuck - 8 oz ground brisket - 8 oz ground boneless short rib

Cook for 1 minute until a crust forms, then flip. Season with salt and pepper, and add a slice of cheese on top. Cook for 1 more minute. - For the Smash Burgers - kosher salt to taste - freshly ground pepper to taste - american cheese slices

Transfer patties to the buns and top with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and special sauce. - For the Smash Burgers - toasted potato buns - butter lettuce leaves - beefsteak tomato sliced - white onion thinly sliced - pickle slices - special sauce (see below)
For the Special Sauce

In a small bowl, mix mayo, ketchup, mustard, grated onion, grated garlic, hot paprika, and relish until combined. - ½ cup mayo - ½ cup ketchup - ⅓ mustard - ¼ onion grated - 1 garlic clove grated - ½ tsp hot paprika - 1 tbsp relish
Optionally, transfer the sauce to a squeeze bottle. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
